dataNote: Protected values are encrypted. Lists and this page show only the last digits; a full value is shown once, for a stated reason, and every reveal is recorded with your name.
noAccess: You can see that sensitive details exist only with identity-check access.
openOnComputer: Open on a computer to reveal
revealRules: Revealed values hide again after 60 seconds or when you leave this page. Every reveal is recorded in the audit log with your name and the reason.
revealAudit: Say why you need the full value. Your reason, not the value, is recorded in the audit log.
reasonDetailHelp: For example the transaction or request this is for. Do not type the value itself.
reasonTooShort: Describe the reason in at least {min} characters.
stepUpDetail: Revealing needs a recent sign-in with your second factor. Sign in again, then reveal the value.
numberHelp: Encrypted when saved. Afterwards only the last four characters are shown.
numberKeep: Leave empty to keep the recorded number (ending {last4}).
duplicateTitle: This number is already recorded for another contact
duplicateDetail: Another contact in your company has a document with the same number. Check it is not the same person; records are never merged automatically.
duplicateContinue: It is a different person: save
archiveDocumentConsequence: It leaves the list but is kept, with your reason. A verified document cannot be changed.
notesHelp: Do not type identity or bank numbers here.
signOffNote: A manager with sign-off rights approves or rejects the check. Once signed off it cannot change.
decisionFinal: The decision is final and is recorded with your name.
queueSubtitle: Checks of the contacts you look after. Decide each one on the contact's Identity tab.

queueEmpty.expiring: No checks due for renewal in the next 30 days

queueEmptyDetail: Identity checks are recorded on a contact's Identity tab.
